designer-initial.summary: Selected a closed small finished-product dispatch design with 6 semantic usages, 11 interactions, 9 ordered cases, 5 scenario families, and one principal state/decision owner.
questions_for_model: Can the trusted SysML-AADL/GUMBO subset express the Dispatch Decision Owner's two local state variables, initialization, ordered pre-state guards, and same-evaluation next-state/output relation without duplicating the principal decision or leaving state unconstrained?

What one-root concrete mapping preserves exactly 6 semantic usages, semantic depth 1..2, one weak semantic region, and the 11 end-to-end semantic interactions while reporting any required containment or boundary delegation separately as uncounted generated support?

Can each of the three qualification usages plus release-command and notice derivation carry a nonidentity owner-local contract without central recomputation that would invalidate semantic-usage credit?

Can an independent deterministic analyzer exhaust all 384 raw state/input snapshots, witness all 9 ordered cases, and execute all 5 scenario families including neutral recovery and a later fresh request without becoming a second architectural decision owner?

model-review.summary: The selected 6/11/9/5 allocation is realizable unchanged and all six usages own nonidentity local behavior.

findings.evidence: Extensionally, PART-01, PART-02, and PART-03 each map four raw value/status pairs to three facts by collapsing both invalid-status pairs; PART-04 performs state-dependent nine-case selection; PART-05 maps nine dispositions to two commands; and PART-06 combines disposition with next phase to derive status and confirmation. None is a one-to-one rename, copy, bundle, or reroute wrapper.

Library commit 9016cbcceefa92f0068e1811923704dd261d15f1 provides System, Process, Thread, structured Data, directed DataPort, and PortConnection. Sireum v4.20260630.386eac9f currently accepts the trusted retained System-to-Process-to-Thread, local-state, record-attribute pattern with exit 0 and Well-formed!.

One root System, one uncounted behavior-free support Process, six semantic Threads, twelve uncounted boundary-delegation routes, and five direct inter-Thread connections realize the eleven end-to-end interactions at depth 2 in one weakly connected semantic region without changing endpoints or owner credit.

Thread-local GUMBO state, explicit initialize guarantees, In(state) pre-state references, post-state guarantees, Data-record attributes, and complete record-output constraints can express PART-04. Because compute cases are conjunctive rather than first-match, generation must encode every earlier-priority exclusion explicitly; this preserves all nine abstract cases unchanged.

Independent enumeration covers exactly 384 raw snapshots and witnesses every case with counts 336, 18, 6, 4, 8, 1, 1, 2, and 8 for CASE-01 through CASE-09. A dependency-free analyzer can compare the same owner-local relations and execute all five scenario families without becoming a second decision owner or formal proof.

The frozen seed declares no executable profile and the System Abstract explicitly sets executable_profile false while deferring code generation, execution, timing, and physical-performance claims. The logical model mapping does not activate executable-agent obligations or expand the claim boundary.

designer-resolution.summary: Approved the unchanged 6/11/9/5 baseline and authorized generation with exact localized support and analysis constraints.
